name: Listening Pine Primer (Thính Tùng Quyết)
concept: The outer gate's method, learned sitting under the pines at dawn and dusk with the eyes shut. Both of its combat arts are Wood (only moc is listed in names so outer disciples with Wood-only roots pass CongPhap.usable; both Wood and Water breathe to it in lore).
lore: Kỳ Tùng Ẩn chanted it to his first hundred disciples in the year 200 (C003), sitting under the pine that still stands in the palace yard. It has never been written down.

name: Pine Wave True Canon (Tùng Đào Chân Kinh)

effects.name: Answering Wave
effects.rule: Each heal from your arts lays one Wood stack on the foe per 1 % of your health restored and gives you one Water stack.

effects.name: The Fifteenth Layer
effects.rule: When you go Down with no refusal, you stay untargetable on the field for 6 s firing each banked wave once a second (c 0.8 split Physical/Cold) until empty or time ends; if the foe falls in the window, the fight is a draw.

concept: The founder's method. The practitioner roots like a pine and lets qi pass through them in long waves that mend, strike, and come back. Layers 1-12 are taught to true disciples and elders; 13-15 only to the head, and the 15th was never spoken aloud.
lore: Kỳ Tùng Ẩn made it in the Wild Age, alone in the pines of Thâm Tùng Hải, from listening. He died in C138 before chanting the fifteenth layer.

name: Rain on the Pine Sea Canon (Tùng Hải Vũ Kinh)
concept: The elders' secret art, made by the River Hall and Lake Hall to give the Water half of the sect a voice of its own: calls a rain Field that feeds healing, linh lực, Water stacks, and Wood duration.
lore: Hề Tùng Ba chanted its first version in 760; Hồ Tùng Nguyệt added the dream-road layers in 1010.

name: Startled Goose Step (Kinh Hồng Bộ)
concept: Thôi Khinh Hồng's own movement art, named for her line: light as a startled swan goose, supple as a swimming dragon. Uses Wood regrowth to power leaps and diving strikes. Swallow Stance is listed in depth prose but omitted here to preserve Wood-only root compatibility.
lore: Made in the 450s to hunt the white wolf king (C093) and taught to no one.

name: Hearth-Simmer Breath (Táo Hạ Văn Hỏa Quyết)
concept: A smokeless Yellow-tier stove-tending breath used by the palace kitchen's Fire-root cooks (Bành Táo Nhi, Phùng Quế Chi) under the pines without raising an open flame.
lore: Kept behind the scullery door so the mountain's pines never smell charcoal.

name: Bark-and-Timber Breath (Mộc Thạch Phụ Trọng Công)
concept: A plain Yellow-tier carrying and loom-steadying breath practiced by Earth-root servants of the outer terrace (Sầm Chức Nương, Mạc Đốn Mộc).
lore: Taught between cart hauls and loom beams when a servant's root has stone in it.
